g.text: Title: Arduino Pro Mini + RFM95W LoRa 868 MHz carrier

g.text: J1 sensor header: RAW VCC D3 SCL SDA GND. Radio: D13 SCK, D12 MISO, D11 MOSI, D10 NSS, D9 RST, D2 DIO0 (muhradio LoRa pinout).

g.desc: J1 sensor header: RAW VCC D3 SCL SDA GND. Radio: D13 SCK, D12 MISO, D11 MOSI, D10 NSS, D9 RST, D2 DIO0 (muhradio LoRa pinout).

g.text: C1 22uF bulk for TX bursts. R1 4.7k = DS18B20 pull-up (DS18B20 nodes only). R2 330R series protection on D3.

g.desc: C1 22uF bulk for TX bursts. R1 4.7k = DS18B20 pull-up (DS18B20 nodes only). R2 330R series protection on D3.

g.text: Remove the Pro Mini power LED and regulator; unplug the battery while programming (FTDI adapter set to 3.3 V).

g.desc: Remove the Pro Mini power LED and regulator; unplug the battery while programming (FTDI adapter set to 3.3 V).

g.text: No regulator by user choice: a full Li-ion cell is 4.2 V, above the CC1101 3.6 V rating. Use protected cells (nothing here stops deep discharge).

g.desc: No regulator by user choice: a full Li-ion cell is 4.2 V, above the CC1101 3.6 V rating. Use protected cells (nothing here stops deep discharge).

g.text: Power: 1S LiPo / 18650 (or 2xAA) straight on VCC via J2 -> Q1 (reverse-polarity P-FET). Measure sleep current in the battery lead at J2.

g.desc: Power: 1S LiPo / 18650 (or 2xAA) straight on VCC via J2 -> Q1 (reverse-polarity P-FET). Measure sleep current in the battery lead at J2.

g.text: FTDI row pads are plated but unconnected.

g.desc: FTDI row pads are plated but unconnected.

g.text: A4/A5 holes match the SparkFun layout; on other clones jumper A4/A5 to J1 SDA/SCL.

g.desc: A4/A5 holes match the SparkFun layout; on other clones jumper A4/A5 to J1 SDA/SCL.

g.text: C2 100nF = reed/button debounce, leave OFF for DS18B20 (1-Wire timing).

g.desc: C2 100nF = reed/button debounce, leave OFF for DS18B20 (1-Wire timing).

g.text: Use a 3.3 V / 8 MHz Pro Mini: the RFM95W is not 5 V tolerant (1.8-3.7 V).

g.desc: Use a 3.3 V / 8 MHz Pro Mini: the RFM95W is not 5 V tolerant (1.8-3.7 V).

g.text: Carrier board: Arduino Pro Mini on top, RFM95W LoRa module on the bottom (muhradio LoRa node).

g.desc: Carrier board: Arduino Pro Mini on top, RFM95W LoRa module on the bottom (muhradio LoRa node).
